# Puppet Desk 1.10.0 · build 91

## Licensing and activation

- New installations require an owner-issued activation code. Ask the publisher privately, then use Enter activation code → Activate. Existing registered installations keep their licence number and active/revoked status.
- Read and affirmatively accept the updated licence agreement before continuing. Puppet Desk is licensed, not sold; the publisher reserves the right to suspend or revoke licences for any reason, to the extent permitted by applicable law.
- Online apps receive signed status changes. A verified revocation stops puppet controls and displays a notice requiring the app to close. A previously active offline copy has no expiry countdown; new status changes cannot reach it until it reconnects. Received revocations remain saved offline.
- Licensing records include first/last IP addresses and limited connection history after agreement acceptance. Licensing does not upload or delete your artwork.

## Update

Close Puppet Desk and run **Update Puppet Desk**. New users can run **Install-Puppet-Desk.exe**, which installs both Puppet Desk and its updater with desktop shortcuts. No GitHub account or GitHub CLI is needed for the public updater.

Owner administration remains exclusive to Development. This release does not include the licence server or its administrative credentials.
